testcase.name: Scenario: Fit a selected planar face: tmp/obk-zoom-48987af/features/application/viewport-zoom/viewport-zoom.feature:60:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Fit a selected planar face ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its visible planar face appears small within the viewport ✔ And the face is selected ✔ When the user chooses Zoom Selected from the navigation bar Zoom menu ✔ Then the selected face appears larger and fills most of the viewport ✔ And the face remains selected ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ And the status area displays Ready ✔ When the user reopens the Zoom menu ✔ Then Zoom Selected is marked as the selected action ✔ When the user selects Zoom and presses Escape ✔ Then the status area displays Ready
